spanish: Sobre carne de hombre no será derramado, y en su proporción no harán como él; santidad él, santidad será a ustedes.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms is active: the 3ms participant performs the action. «será derramado» is passive, so the stem force changes and that participant becomes the one acted on.

notes: 2mp «harán» and «ustedes» match the plural address; both קדש clauses stay open.
